title: Sands Fall Immediately
description: Make falling blocks such as sand, red sand, anvil, and dragon egg fall immediately when they can
body:
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/sands-fall-immediately?logo=modrinth&label=&suffix=%20&style=flat&color=242629&labelColor=5ca424&logoColor=1c1c1c)](https://modrinth.com/mod/sands-fall-immediately)
[![Curseforge](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/1515444.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sands-fall-immediately)

Make falling blocks such as sand, red sand, anvil, and dragon egg fall immediately when they can, instead of delaying 2 ticks or 5 ticks.

The mod can be disabled in config without restarting the game.

Technical detail: Change the scheduling of a scheduled tick in `FallingBlock` to execute it immediately.
